summary: Tests that the case evidence grouping keeps core records first and puts fixture material in a separate group without changing the records.
purpose: Proves that grouping for display does not alter the stored records.
why: Likely reason: the grouping is presentation only, so the test checks the data stays as it was. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Builds one core record and one fixture record, runs the grouping, and checks the core record sits in the core group, the fixture sits in the supporting group, and neither record's state or synthetic flag changed.
inputs: Two small sample document records built in the test.
outputs: Pass or fail for the grouping test.
risks: Only one scenario is covered, with one record of each kind.
debug: If it fails, check the fixture naming rule in the grouping function, since the test depends on the id text.
